Round 470 is planned and the decision in `b-next.json` is **CONTINUE**. Round 469 is not accepted: C's verdict was BLOCKED, the gate skipped it, and its diff is still uncommitted in the store tree, untouched by me.

**What happened in round 469.** C passed C2–C13 in the real browser. C1, the HEAD control, failed three times because it counted frames over 33.4 ms and needed a median of at least 5. On this machine HEAD's dropped frames sit at 33.2–33.3 ms, just under that cutoff. C's own data still shows a clean split using p95 instead:

| Build | Frozen `/` passes with p95 ≥ 33 ms |
|---|---|
| HEAD, C's round-469 data | 17 of 18 |
| HEAD, my re-run here | 6 of 6 |
| HEAD, earlier runs by A, B and C | every pass |
| Fixed tree (C's runs) | 0 of 18 (all ≤ 16.8 ms) |
| Fixed variants (earlier frozen runs) | none (all ≤ 16.8 ms) |

So the fix works; only the control's metric was wrong.

**C's bug C-R469-01.** The new glow was flatter and wider than HEAD's even though its average brightness was in range. I ruled it Low but fix it now, because round 470 owns those same three unpublished lines. I built and measured six candidates and picked s6:
- **Shape:** every bright patch is 0.78–1.08× HEAD's, and no patch differs by more than 0.78 levels (the round-469 version was 2.64–2.77).
- **Brightness:** section averages are 0.94–1.21× HEAD's, inside the 0.8–1.3 band.
- **Edges:** no seam; edge jumps stay within HEAD's + 1.
- **Scrolling:** no slow frames in either problem band.
- **Guard test:** SP1–SP3 pass.

**Consults.** product-designer looked at s6 and said it can't be told apart from today's glow and would ship it as is. Its weakest spot is the upper-right accent patch at 0.79×, which C will crop and record. tech-lead approved the sketch (s4) and the s4 → s6 change.

**Round 470 task:**
- **A:**
  - applies `b-round-469/sketch-470.patch.txt`, which only touches the scale and colour-stop classes on ProductSection lines 38–39 and StudioShowcase line 75;
  - updates doc 305, including status "Completed (C round 470 PASS)";
  - leaves the test file unchanged.
- **C:**
  - **Control and frames:** C1 now passes when HEAD has p95 ≥ 33 ms in at least 2 of 3 passes per viewport. The fixed tree must have p95 ≤ 17 ms in at least 8 of 9 passes, with any cluster of slow frames in a problem band still a hard FAIL.
  - **Shape rows:** C6b–C6d check bright patches, the largest patch difference and a one-sided shift, using the round-469 build as the version that must fail.
  - **The rest:** all the round-469 rows, the auth and Studio smoke check, and the claims script, which runs clean with nothing missing.

**Bookkeeping:**
- `backlog.json` has decisions D-29z1652–1655 and the open finding C-R469-01.
- A's code-reviewer architecture note is recorded as a signal, and the regex gap it found is moved to the deferred Lows.
- The "look-control" pattern has now happened twice, so I merged it into lessons L58; the file is still 60 lines.
- I added a RETRO 480 counter for basing a frame-time control on a single machine.
- `feature-status.md` is updated.

Nothing is marked done (მზადაა). SABA-B-15 closes only after C passes round 470 and Saba checks scrolling on his own device. The regression round is due at the next planning, 2026-11-13 or later.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, once after orientation and once before hand-off. It caught three problems, all fixed: the C2 frame limit came from one machine only, one claim read a build that won't exist on C's fresh machine, and product-designer's "none" had been given on s4, not on s6.
